mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110), supply chain bottlenecks ease, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past quarter signals strong labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) annual inflation above 2.0% signals inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift in economic activity from construction to manufacturing, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% and HOUST declines by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS growth > 1.0% quarterly), retail sales growth supports corporate revenue, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when RSAFS growth > 1.0%.
